title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Generate descriptive statistics measures location, dispersion, frequency tables, cross tables, group summaries multiple one/two way tables.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Visualize compute percentiles/probabilities normal, t, f, chi square binomial distributions.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Select set parametric non-parametric statistical tests. ‘inferr’ builds upon solid set statistical tests provided ‘stats’ package including additional data types inputs, expanding restructuring test results. tests included t tests, variance tests, proportion tests, chi square tests, Levene’s test, McNemar Test, Cochran’s Q test Runs test.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Tools designed make easier users, particularly beginner/intermediate R users build ordinary least squares regression models. Includes comprehensive regression output, heteroskedasticity tests, collinearity diagnostics, residual diagnostics, measures influence, model fit assessment variable selection procedures.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Tools designed make easier beginner intermediate users build validate binary logistic regression models. Includes bivariate analysis, comprehensive regression output, model fit statistics, variable selection procedures, model validation techniques ‘shiny’ app interactive model building.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Tools RFM (recency, frequency monetary value) analysis. Generate RFM score transaction customer level data. Visualize relationship recency, frequency monetary value using heatmap, histograms, bar charts scatter plots.

title: Tools for Interactive Data Exploration
text: Tools interactive data visualization . Users can visualize data using ‘ggplot2’, ‘plotly’, ‘rbokeh’ ‘highcharter’ libraries.
